page: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-144-lssd is a compute-optimized instance featuring 144 vCPUs mapped to 72 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor running at 2.3 GHz. The architecture is x86_64 with dedicated CPU allocation and hyperthreading enabled. It is equipped with 540 GB of RAM, providing 3.75 GB of memory per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of 24 NVMe SSDs totaling 9383 GB of capacity. No GPUs are present on this instance type.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier multi-core CPU performance, with stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU scores all ranking in the top 10% of tested systems. Conversely, single-core CPU performance in stress-ng falls within the middle 50%, highlighting a performance tradeoff between massive parallelization and individual core speed. Memory bandwidth is exceptionally high, with both small-block cached reads and large-block uncached reads and writes placing in the top 10%. The system also demonstrates top-tier capabilities in database operations, static web serving throughput, and multi-threaded decompression.

The inclusion of Advanced Matrix Extensions and AVX-512 instructions supports specialized workloads. LLM inference benchmarks show top-tier prompt processing speeds across small, medium, and large models, though text generation speeds for large models drop to the top 25% and small models to the middle 50%. Given the high density of dedicated CPU cores and massive local NVMe storage, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for highly parallelized, I/O-intensive workloads such as large-scale databases, real-time analytics, and software compilation, where local storage speed and memory bandwidth prevent CPU starvation.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-144-lssd is a compute-optimized instance featuring 144 vCPUs across 72 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor, 540 GB of RAM, and 9383 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. Operating on the x86_64 architecture, this server delivers top-tier multi-core CPU performance and memory bandwidth, though single-core performance remains in the middle 50%. The processor supports Advanced Matrix Extensions and AVX-512, enabling top-tier prompt processing speeds for LLM inference. With 24 local SSDs, the instance is engineered for data-intensive, highly parallel workloads. It is well-suited for large-scale database operations, multi-threaded software compilation, and high-throughput web serving.
